newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka projects 5.5 percent GDP growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka projects 5.5 percent GDP growth in 1997.

text.p: Sri Lankan Deputy Finance Minister G.L. Peiris said the government projects gross domestic product aPLGDP will grow more than 5.5 percent in calendar 1997, an improvement over estimate growth of 3.7 percent this year.
"The economy is poised to recover next year from depressed conditions this year," Peiris told parliament as he presented the state budget for calendar 1997.
"The economy is expected to exceed its average growth level of 5.5 percent in 1997," he said.
GDP grew 5.5 percent in 1995, but drought and resulting hydroelectric power shortages hurt 1996 growth, he said.
